summary: Build GMP control, CAPA, and inspection readiness in 5 days. Train with practical templates, casework, and quality system tools.
lede: GxP training courses help pharmaceutical professionals apply quality systems and maintain reliable records across regulated operations. They support staff responsible for quality assurance, laboratory work, manufacturing, validation, and audits in investigating deviations, managing CAPA and change control, and preparing inspection-ready documentation. Learners also practice root cause analysis, data integrity reviews, supplier oversight, and quality trend reporting using tools and exercises from the syllabus.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in regulated pharmaceutical environments and need stronger control over quality systems, compliance evidence, and inspection readiness.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of pharmaceutical operations, GMP documentation, and routine quality or laboratory workflows; familiarity with SOPs, deviations, CAPA, and change control is helpful. No coding is required, but you should be prepared to work with sample batch records, audit checklists, deviation reports, and quality metrics during the course. Advanced concepts such as computerized system oversight and quality risk management are taught at an operational application level, not at engineering depth.
